name: evidentum
description: Self-contained systematic review workbench — multi-database search, dual-reviewer screening, AI-assisted critical appraisal (RoB 2, ROBINS-I, GRADE…). One HTML file, no backend, data never leaves your browser.

paragraphs: A self-contained systematic review search & appraisal workbench. Search across major biomedical databases, screen and de-duplicate results, run AI-assisted critical appraisal, and assemble PRISMA-ready records — all from a single HTML file that runs in your browser. Installable as an app, offline-capable, light or dark theme, and with no project-operated backend — your projects stay in your browser (see Privacy & data flow for what does travel to external services).
Status: Beta. Features and interfaces are still changing between builds.
